source.scope: Current infrastructure associated with UMDO+ only.

available_labs.laboratory: Chemical Synthesis Lab for Advanced Semiconductor Films
equipment: Multiple spin coaters and 2 blade coaters (ambient and glovebox)
2 gloveboxes (one coupled to high-vacuum thermal evaporator)
UV mask aligners (MJB3 and MJB4, UV nanoimprint option)
Direct laser writing systems (homebuilt and UVW03)
PECVD system and rapid thermal process/spray CVD

available_labs.laboratory: Optical Characterization Lab for Semiconductors and Quantum Dots
equipment: Hamamatsu PMT and NIR detectors up to 1700 nm
Spectral responsivity and EQE setup (300-1700 nm)
Probe stations for ambient and vacuum/gas operation (80-300 K)
CW and pulsed lasers (visible and NIR ranges)
Spectrographs, UV-Vis reflectometry and lock-in electronics
Dedicated HPC servers for ab initio and photonics simulations
Ti:sapphire, diode and pulsed laser excitation platforms
CCD and InGaAs detection chains with dedicated spectrometers
